sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:4

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:4:1
items.html: In their posterior there was some breaking etc., and there is no actual dross in them: That is, although the GAR of Atzilut too were not completely sorted, and the posteriors that fell from them at the time of the breaking of the vessels do not rise completely to their place until the end of correction, nevertheless this gives no grip whatsoever to the shells, since these posteriors never went out of the world of Atzilut at all, but only descended from a high degree to a lowly degree. This is not so with the ZAT of Nekudim, which are called ZON: they do have actual dross in them, as written above, and for this reason they died and fell to the worlds of separation. Therefore, since these vessels were not completely sorted, but much dross remained inside the shells, to the measure that they hold of these vessels of the ZAT in their domain, they have a grip on ZON as well, as is written of this thoroughly in its place.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 7:4:2
items.html: All the shells cling to ZON alone, and not from Ima upward: As written above in the adjacent item, only from the vessels of ZA did unsorted parts remain inside the shells, and therefore they have a grip on him. This is not so from Ima upward, where nothing at all fell to the portion of the shells; therefore the shells have no grip whatsoever from Ima upward.
